description: Every stable diagnostic identifier a conforming adapter emits. Codes never change meaning; a new one is added here, explained in docs/diagnostics.md, and emitted only through a named constant.

native.meaning: A save carried a version that is no longer current; the writer sees both versions and loses nothing.
The requested address belongs to another piece, live or historical.
The piece, revision, or media the request named does not exist.
A field broke a rule the editor also enforces; the message names the field.
SQLite refused or failed a query; check the database file and the disk.
An admin page could not be rendered from its embedded template.
Sessions, tokens, or recovery codes could not be read or written.
A passkey ceremony failed or did not match the site's origin.
An upload could not be decoded or re-encoded; the limit or the file is named.
Media records or files could not be read or written.
Publishing on request failed; the last complete release stays visible.
The public site could not be compiled from the current snapshot.
A stored release object or manifest failed its checksum; run doctor.
The active release names an object that is not in the store.
The release store could not be read.
An unexpected failure; the request ID leads to the trace with the cause.
A client exceeded the authentication or like rate limit; Retry-After says when to try again.
The public snapshot could not be read from the database.
The compiler rejected the snapshot; the site keeps its last release.
The compiled release could not be stored or activated.
The scheduler could not read the publication clock; it retries with backoff.
Writing a content-addressed object to the release store failed.
Writing the release manifest failed; nothing was activated.
The active pointer could not be switched; the previous release stays active.
A scheduled backup could not be written; the next run tries again.

cloudflare.meaning: A required binding, secret, or zone setting of the worker is missing or malformed.
The site registry database did not answer a probe.
A site's durable object did not answer a probe.
The host routing store did not answer a probe.
The release object store did not answer a probe.
The multi-site Core service did not answer its health check.
